title: US Supreme Court legalises same-sex marriage
summary: In Obergefell v. Hodges the Supreme Court ruled that same-sex couples have a constitutional right to marry.
reason: Plaintiffs challenged state bans after years of rapid change in public opinion.
significance: It made same-sex marriage legal in all fifty states.
participants: Supreme Court of the United States
place: Supreme Court Building, Washington, D.C., United States
